notes.title: Update ver. 0.5109
notes.content:
ver. 0.5109

- If the tutorial has not been cleared, the portal to exit the tutorial in "Tutorial: MenuScreen" has been hidden.
- If the tutorial has been cleared, the portal to re-enter the tutorial from the normal stage has been hidden.
This is to prevent players from getting lost on their first playthrough.

- The default value for displaying the stage time on the screen has been changed to hidden.
- Fixed an issue where the jumping action would continue after the scene changed if you died while riding a golem or retried while getting off the golem.
- Fixed anti-aliasing when graphics quality is set to Low.
- Fixed several other display issues.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.5108

- Fixed an issue where monster death animations would sometimes not start.
- Fixed an issue where long-distance attack animations continued to move while paused.
- Lantern lighting now works correctly with the Pause state.
- Fixed an issue where monsters would appear to disappear just before traveling to the world map.
- Tips at the bottom right of the world map will be displayed at the appropriate time.
- Message box buttons are now highlighted when the mouse cursor is placed over them.

notes.title: DEMO version released
notes.content:
The pre-release DEMO version has been released to the public.
I hope you enjoy it!

This reflects feedback on the Steam Next Fest DEMO released in the fall of 2024.
The purpose of releasing this DEMO is to get your feedback.
Please send your [b]comments[/b] to the [b]community[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787839/869e2328d706442db7cb81e97ee6a82d91cd0096.png[/img]

[h2]Request[/h2]
I've been so busy with development work that I haven't been able to adequately publicize and promote the game.
It would be a great help if you could spread the word about this game and the DEMO version to those around you.


[h2]DEMO version store page released.[/h2]
This will allow you to post a "review of the DEMO version".
If you like this game, I would be very grateful if you would write a review!

notes.title: DEMO is in preparation
notes.content:
I am currently preparing a new [b]Pre-release DEMO [/b](ver. 0.5) that incorporates feedback from the NextFest DEMO (ver. 0.4) in 2024.
I will let you know when it is ready.

[h2]Caution[/h2]
Prior to that notice, a version of the DEMO in preparation may be temporarily placed in a public status, but this should not be used.
This is open to the public for internal work and applications.
It may contain bugs or incomplete work.

notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
I am currently working on incorporating the feedback I received at the Next Fest.
Because this is a major overhaul, the DEMO is currently not available to the public.

A simple roadmap
[list]
(2024)
[*] 1. Separate Jump and Dodge inputs and change behavior and motions.
[*] 2. Adjust the timing of enemy attack damage occurrence, etc.
[*] 3. Improve the presentation when attacking and taking damage.
[*] 4. I would like to re-release the DEMO.

(Winter 2025)
[*] 5. Implement other improvements and additional elements.

(Spring 2025-)
[*] 6. Implement the final stage.
[*] 7. Implement the final boss.

(Summer 2025-)
[*] 8. It's finished!
[/list]
I am currently working on step 1.
I would like to re-release the DEMO once steps 1 through 3 are complete.
I would appreciate your feedback at that time!!!


I've received a lot of great feedback, and it's all been really helpful.
I would like to reflect these as much as possible even if it means delaying the release date.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4601
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4601

- Added a warning NPC to a difficult small room in the Ruins of Winds #3.

- Added a warning message to the bridge being chased by 3 enemies in Ruins of Winds #5.

- A tutorial message will be displayed after a certain number of deaths in the boss stage.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4511
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4511

- Improved Simplified Chinese translation.

- Improved the accuracy of the item radar.
Accuracy changes depending on the distance to the item, but now the distance is only evaluated horizontally.
This means that the item radar will be at its most accurate if you are directly below or above an item, no matter how far away you are vertically.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4510
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4510

- Result illustrations and story illustrations have been added.
If you select Japanese as the language, the illustrator's name will be displayed in Japanese.
If you select a language other than Japanese, the illustrator's name will be displayed in the alphabet.

- Added an explanatory NPC to the scene where you first obtain mana in Ruins of Wind #1.
However, there was not much that could be explained.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4509
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4509

- If you have mana in your bag, the conversation about giving it to Miche will now be displayed even while Dashing.
Normally, conversation popups with NPCs are omitted while sprinting.
If you have mana, simply dashing past Miche will seal it.

- When re-entering the same stage from the world map, it is no longer necessary to move the cursor.
A confirmation message box will be displayed when re-entering the same stage.
This is to prevent accidental operation by pressing the "OK" button when displaying the story, etc.

- The fanfare when defeating a boss has been slightly changed.

- The initial field design of Ruins of Wind #1 has been slightly changed.
This was because many players were accidentally entering the portal that led to the first tutorial.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4507
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4507

- The specifications and design of the [Control Settings] screen have been changed.

- A function has been added to the keyboard key settings that detects and assigns entered keys.

- The default assignment for "Retry (Restart Stage from Beginning)" for Xbox and PlayStation controllers has been changed to "Unassigned."

[strike]- When controlling a character in a normal stage with the keyboard, the mouse cursor is now hidden.
The cursor will appear immediately when you move the mouse.[/strike]
It's canceled.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4506
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4506

- The game is now fully localized in Simplified Chinese.

- Fixed some visual issues with portals related to entering and exiting the tutorial.
No changes to destinations, etc.

- Removed a wall in Ruins of Light #1&#3 that prevented passage until time had elapsed.

- Fixed terrain in Ruins of Wind #1 that could cause players to get stuck.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4505
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4505

- Changed the color of portals to enter tutorials that have not been completed to blue.
Changed the color of portals to enter tutorials that have been completed to green.

- Changed the key help for entering portals to different sentences for the following types of portals.
Finish Stage
Start Tutorial
Leave Tutorial
Next Tutorial
Finish Tutorial
Enter Portal (all other than the above)

- Changed the sound effect when defeating a boss.

- Changed the sound effect when completing a tutorial.

- Fixed an issue where the direction of Kijino's character at the start of some stages did not match the direction of the stage.

- Fixed an issue in Ruins of Light #3 where the goal door would not open if you moved to another stage without picking up the key to the goal door.
If you leave the area without picking up an important item such as a key, the item will be relocated to the spawn position of the mob that had it.
In Ruins of Light #3, the mob falls from the ceiling, so the key was also relocated to the ceiling.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4504
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4504

- Fixed a bug that prevented dodge inputs from being used when there was an object on Kijino's head.
When Kijino hits his head on the ceiling, the upward movement of his jump ends there, which is currently by design.
However, we are planning to revise the entire jump action in the future.

- An emotion is now displayed when Nyanko Sensei is able to rebuild the Goddess Statue.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4502
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4502

- Slightly increased the size of the item radar (both default and large display).

- To prevent conversation popups from appearing during battle, monsters can no longer approach NPCs that are having a conversation.

- Changed the color of the damage numbers received by golems from blue to dark yellow.

notes.title: Update ver. 0.4501
notes.content:
Update ver. 0.4501

- Fixed a bug in the process of determining whether or not a Challenge (Achievement) was completed.
When "Retry (Restart Stage from Beginning)" in a normal stage or entering and exiting a tutorial stage, the start process, such as tallying up the challenge completion conditions, was not performed correctly.

- Fixed a bug that restricted jumping in front of "Sold out" items in street stalls.
When in front of a stall item, the same button operations as for purchasing are restricted.

- The currently selected item is now highlighted in [Display Settings] and [Language Settings].

- The English translation is now better.


Notice:
Steam achievements will not be unlocked in the DEMO version.
You can only earn in-game trophies.
When you launch the full version, all Steam achievements linked to in-game trophies will be unlocked.

---
Thank you for your feedback on the DEMO.
We have categorized the feedback we received as follows, and we are correcting 1) and 2) while the DEMO is open to the public.
3) and 4) will remain as is for this Steam Next Fest DEMO, and will adjust them after the release is over.

1) Bugs
2) Improving player convenience
3) Adjusting parameters within the current specifications
4) Reviewing the current specifications

We appreciate your continued support for this DEMO and your feedback.

notes.title: Demo version released
notes.content:
The demo version of the game has been released to the public.
We have also prepared a store page specifically for the demo version, so please check there for details.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3190930/_DEMO/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3190930/_DEMO/[/url]

[h3]Important Notice[/h3]
[b]This demo version was prepared for the Steam Next Fest,
so it will be disabled after the festival period (until October 21, 2024) ends.[/b]


The reason for releasing the demo is as written on the store page,
but it also comes from wanting to show our progress to everyone who has been following the game's development up until now.
I hope you enjoy it!
